\[
I_{\text{out}}(x, y) = I(x, y) + A \sin\left(2\pi (f_x x + f_y y) + \varphi\right),\quad A = 40,\ f_x = 0.125,\ f_y = 0
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(A\): The amplitude in 8-bit levels
- \(f_x, f_y\): The frequency in cycles per pixel
- \(\varphi\): The phase

x and y are the image position of the pixel, so a region gives the same noise as the whole image. The wave makes two peaks in the spectrum, at (f_x, f_y) and at (-f_x, -f_y). This is the model of periodic noise in Gonzalez and Woods. Results outside 0 to 255 are clipped.
